tool: none - this record documents WHERE and HOW an animated frame set is recorded, and covers no file of its own
covers: no file. A frame set is several files under ONE record, and that record lives BESIDE THE CELLS, in anim/<portraitAsset>/provenance.json - which is where the directory sweep in scripts/asset-provenance.test.mjs looks, because anim/<key>/ is an art directory of its own. The record carries the master it was split from, the splitter that cut it, the measured per-cell and per-set cost, and whether the cells were graded on the way in (a derived set ingests --no-grade, because its source grade is already baked in; only newly generated cells take the full recipe). The first one is anim/float-eye/provenance.json, written by phase AN1e. See docs/asset-conventions.md, 'Enemy frame sets'.
